title: Branching rule for $SL_{n+m}(\mathbb{C})\supset SL_n(\mathbb{C})\times SL_m(\mathbb{C})$
summary: We study the branching problem for the pair $SL_{n+m}(\mathbb{C})\supset SL_n(\mathbb{C})\times SL_m(\mathbb{C})$. We describe the corresponding branching rule in terms of a semigroup $Σ_{n,m}\subsetΛ^{+}\times\mathbb{Z}^N$, where $Λ^{+}$ is the semigroup of dominant weights of $SL_{n+m}$, and $N$ is the dimension of maximal unipotent subgroup in $SL_{n+m}$. Let $V(λ)$ be the irreducible representation of $SL_{n+m}$ with the highest weight $λ$.
